## Description

Transforms multi-scale persistence diagrams into persistence landscapes to quantify topological cycle stability in rolling correlation point clouds, executing relative value trades on landscape norm divergences.

## Where it may fit

Statistical arbitrage across multi-asset classes, oscillatory market regime transitions.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Desks, Quantitative Multi-Asset Funds.

## Required data

Multivariate rolling distance matrices, asset return series, liquidity metrics.
